dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: This land holds nothing but promise for adventurers from all walks of life. Wouldn't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And you are...?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Hello. I'm Sarin, the head of the Adventurers' Guild's branch in Nasha Town.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: If you need any assistance, or even just want to hear about which local berries are the sweetest, just come look for me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Tell me a bit about Nod-Krai...

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Hehe, a land that holds countless ancient secrets is perfect for us adventurers. Isn't it wonderful?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: May your adventures be fruitful, just like those of everyone else who sets foot on this land.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Same to you. Go well.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you have any special commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Special commissions? Those only come in on special days.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Speaking of which... is it snowing outside?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Snowing? Not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I see... In that case, the emissary who brings the commissions won't be coming today.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Thank you for your patronage. If you're looking for special commissions, I suggest you come back another day.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Any special commissions on the docket?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Lady Nefer? I didn't expect you to visit here in person. But what about Jahoda? By all accounts, there shouldn't be anything recently that requires your personal attention.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I heard that the nor{RUBY#[S]Fatui have stepped up their vigilance}th wind has been strong these days. If Jahoda were sent running errands in this cold, she might freeze along the way.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: So I came by myself to hear your thoughts on the recent weather.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: No need to worry — the weather's been mostly clear these past few days, just a little chilly, but not enough to bring a s{RUBY#[D]large-scale action}nowstorm in. If snow were expected, the A{RUBY#[D]Snezhnograd Veche}dventurers' Guild would make sure to notify you so you could prepare for the cold.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: That's a relief. It seems you really do have the best insight when it comes to the weather.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: Indeed. You see, our work involves coordinating adventurers from across the nations and supporting their expeditions. Weather greatly affects adventures — it's something we must keep track of.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Since there won't be snow, I'll take my leave for now. I hope your work continues smoothly, and please pass a word to that ol{RUBY#[S]The Rooster}d gentleman for me: Snowfall doesn't only affect us. He'll feel the chill just the same.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I will. Thank you for the kind words, Lady Nefer. May you have a good day!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Do you have any special commissions?

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I didn't expect you to come to the Adventurers' Guild, Miss Jahoda. Hehe, let me guess... Lady Nefer asked you to come by and pick up the latest weat{RUBY#[D]Fatui deployment log}her records?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Tch, stop acting like you can tell what everyone wants without asking. That's so annoying. If you've got it, just hand it over quickly. Boss Nef wants to see if there will be a snow{RUBY#[D]large-scale operation}storm in the coming days.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: No need to be impatient, Miss Jahoda. W{RUBY#[D]the Snezhnograd Veche}e can't decide when the snow will fall. But like you, we don't want to see such terrible weather either.

dialogues.speaker: Sarin
dialogues.text: I'll arrange for an adventurer to deliver the weather records that Lady Nefer needs. Have a pleasant day ahead, Miss Jahoda.
